releaseTitle: AdSkip Pro v1.0.44 - Total Cache Purge & Proactive InMobi Multi-Zone Engine
releaseNotes:
* Auto-Purge Legacy AdChoices DB Patterns: Automatically purges stale/corrupted top-right AdChoices false-positive records from Room DB upon startup
* Tier-1 On-the-Fly Cache Eviction: Dynamically intercepts and evicts any legacy AdChoices patterns (normX > 850 && normY < 180) from visual pattern memory
* Deterministic InMobi Screen Classification: Identifies InMobiAdActivity and unhandled WebView containers before screen evaluation, preventing false transitions
* Proactive 2.0s/3.5s InMobi Auto-Dismiss: Dispatches direct Top-Left dismiss taps at (103, 175) and (84, 312) after 2.0s without waiting for long timeouts
* External App Escape Instant Recovery: Detects external shopping/browser redirects (e.g. Myntra) and issues sub-80ms global back recoveries
